            "updateCount": 0
        }
    ],
    "total": 1,
    "offset": 0,
    "limit": 1000
}

Execute request for configuration

Execute the Stats Collection or Y.1731 operation.

Use the Market API to submit the configure request.

Sample request:

POST {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{RID}/operations

Request body for Stats Collection configuration:

{
	"interface": "statsConfiguration",
	"inputs": {
		"freId": "-4598107329044812913",
		"operation": "on"
	}
}

Sample response:

{
    "id": "60c7ac4c-ff09-4ed0-9325-13a45e51d8da",
    "resourceId": "60c72633-47b9-4887-b529-40aaff48a7f0",
    "interface": "statsConfiguration",
    "inputs": {
        "freId": "-4598107329044812913",
        "operation": "on"
    },
    "outputs": {},
    "state": "requested",
    "reason": "",
    "progress": [],
    "providerData": {},

}

Retrieve the result to confirm the operation

A loop is needed at the caller side to continually check the result state is successful/failed.

Use the Market API to retrieve the operation status.

Sample request:

GET {BP_SERVER}/bpocore/market/api/v1/resources/{RID}/operations/{OID}

Sample successful response:

{

Embedded Ethernet link edit operation through REST API

Use this procedure to perform edit label operation on Embedded Ethernet Link. Edit label operation workflow for an Embedded Ethernet link is the same as editing the label of a Non-Control Plane transport client services (REST and GUI).

Prerequisites

Before you begin:

  • Local and remote network elements should be synced successfully in Navigator MC.

  • Line modules (and pluggable, if applicable) supporting connection endpoints must be provisioned on the network element.

Embedded Ethernet link resize operation through REST API

Use this procedure to perform the resize operation on Embedded Ethernet Link. This operation will internally validate the available bandwidth on the entities involved in the route of an Embedded Ethernet Link. In case if requested bandwidth is available then the operation will be successful else route related error will be shown to the user.

Prerequisites

Before you begin:

  • Local and remote network elements should be synced successfully in Navigator MC.

  • Line modules (and pluggable, if applicable) supporting connection endpoints must be provisioned on the network element.

API calls for testing packet infrastructure

This section describes the API calls used to test packet infrastructure managed by Navigator MC:

  • Retrieve operational status of G.8032 Ring

Retrieve operational status of G.8032 Ring

To retrieve the operational status of a G.8032 Ring, use the Test and diagnostics API.

Sample request:

GET {NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST}/tdc/api/v1/operationalStatus?freId=<FRE ID> &osTypeString=ccStatus

CFM Linktrace and CFM Loopback tests are currently not supported on G.8032 Rings.

API calls for updating GCS property

To retrieve an existing GCS config property, use Global Config Service API as below:

Sample URL:

https://<NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST>/gcs/api/v2/config?application=<Name of the application>&instance=<instance>&partition=<partition>&name=<Name of the GCS property to be retrieved>

Sample response:

[
  {
    "application": "<Name of the application> i.e. bpo-ifd",
    "instance": "<instance> i.e. -",
    "partition": "<partition> i.e. l2",
    "name": "<Name of the GCS property retrieved> i.e. multiSHIMProvEnabled",
    "title": "<Title of the GCS property retrieved>",
    "description": "<Description of the GCS property retrieved>",
    "value": "<Current value of the GCS property retrieved>",
    "default": "<Default value of the GCS property retrieved>",
    "key": "<key in format: application/instance/partition/name> i.e. bpo-ifd/-/l2/multiSHIMProvEnabled"
  }
]

To update an existing GCS config property, use Global Config Service API as below:

Sample request:

PATCH <NAVIGATOR_MC_HOST>/gcs/api/v1/config

[
  {
    "application": "<Name of the application> i.e. bpo-ifd",
    "instance": "<instance> i.e. -",
    "partition": "<Name of the partition> i.e. l2",
    "name": "<Name of the GCS property to update>",
    "title": "<Optional, Title of the GCS property to update>",
    "description": "<Optional, Description of the GCS property to update>",
    "default": "<Optional, Default value of the GCS property to update>",
    "value": "<new value of the GCS property to update>"
  }
]
